title: The Crown
cast: Claire Foy, Matt Smith, Gillian Anderson
description: This drama follows the political rivalries and romance of Queen Elizabeth II's reign and the events that shaped the second half of the 20th Century.

title: Stranger Things
cast: Millie Bobby Brown, Winona Ryder, David Harbour
description: When a young boy goes missing, his friends, family and local police go on a search to find him, and uncover a mystery involving secret government experiments, terrifying supernatural forces and a strange little girl.

title: The Office
cast: Steve Carell, Rainn Wilson, John Krasinski
description: A mockumentary on a group of typical office workers, where the workday consists of ego clashes, inappropriate behavior, tedium and romance.

title: Inception
cast: Leonardo DiCaprio, Ellen Page, Joseph Gordon-Levitt
description: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a C.E.O.

title: Breaking Bad
cast: Bryan Cranston, Aaron Paul, Anna Gunn
description: A high school chemistry teacher diagnosed with inoperable lung cancer turns to cooking methamphetamine with a former student in order to secure his family's financial future.

title: The Dark Knight
cast: Christian Bale, Heath Ledger, Aaron Eckhart
description: When the menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham, Batman must accept one of the greatest psychological and physical tests of his ability to fight injustice.

title: Parasite
cast: Song Kang-ho, Lee Sun-kyun, Cho Yeo-jeong
description: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

title: Narcos
cast: Wagner Moura, Pedro Pascal, Boyd Holbrook
description: A chronicled look at the criminal exploits of Colombian drug lord Pablo Escobar, as well as the many other drug kingpins who plagued the country through the years.

title: The Irishman
cast: Robert De Niro, Al Pacino, Joe Pesci
description: An aging hitman recalls his past in a career spanning three decades, revealing a complex web of lies beneath the surface of his work.

title: Money Heist
cast: Álvaro Morte, Itziar Ituño, Úrsula Corberó
description: Eight thieves take hostages and lock themselves in the Royal Mint of Spain as a criminal mastermind manipulates the police to carry out his plan.

title: Dune
cast: Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Oscar Isaac
description: Paul Atreides, a brilliant young man, must travel to the dangerous planet Dune to ensure the future of his family and people as a war erupts over the planet's valuable spice.

title: Squid Game
cast: Lee Jung-jae, Park Hae-soo, Jung Ho-yeon
description: Hundreds of cash-strapped contestants accept an invitation to compete in children's games for a massive prize, but the stakes are deadly.

title: The Witcher
cast: Henry Cavill, Anya Chalotra, Freya Allan
description: Geralt of Rivia, a solitary monster hunter, struggles to find his place in a world where people often prove more wicked than beasts.

title: The Crown
cast: Olivia Colman, Tobias Menzies, Marion Bailey
description: As the 1970s unfold and the Cold War deepens, Elizabeth and her family find themselves preoccupied with metro politics at home and abroad.

title: Glass Onion
cast: Daniel Craig, Edward Norton, Janelle Monáe
description: Investigator Blanc travels to an island in the Mediterranean to uncover the truth behind a tech billionaire's mysterious murder.

title: Dahmer
cast: Evan Peters, Niecy Nash, Richard Jenkins
description: This series examines the gruesome and fascinating case of Jeffrey Dahmer and the systemic failures that enabled one of history's most notorious killers.

title: Avatar
cast: Sam Worthington, Zoe Saldana, Sigourney Weaver
description: A paraplegic Marine dispatched to the moon Pandora on a unique mission becomes torn between following orders and protecting the world he feels is his home.

title: Bridgerton
cast: Phoebe Dynevor, Regé-Jean Page, Jonathan Bailey
description: The eight close-knit siblings of the powerful Bridgerton family explore love, lust, and betrayal in high society during the Regency era.

title: The Handmaid's Tale
cast: Elisabeth Moss, Yvonne Strahovski, Samira Wiley
description: In a dystopian and patriarchal society, a woman is forced into sexual servitude, and her only method of resistance is her character.

title: Oppenheimer
cast: Cillian Murphy, Emily Blunt, Matt Damon
description: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer's role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II.
